flipToBack.timing: Table-changed poll against a persistent state check (GameConditions.isBlownAway, NOT isBlownAwayLastStep) - fires on the first table change once Tracked Fleet has been 'annihilated'
flipToBack.prose: Flip if Tracked Fleet is 'annihilated' - coded as the blown-away state of Filters.Tracked_Fleet.

flipToFront.prose: The back (The Resistance Is Doomed) has no flip-back trigger; verified no FlipCardEffect anywhere in Card225_032_BACK.java. Instead the back carries a place-out-of-play hazard: if Kylo was just forfeited to Lost Pile from Salt Plateau during a battle you lost there with Han, Leia, or Luke present, the objective is placed out of play (Card225_032_BACK.java:98-111).

requirementSemantics: Flip-to-back is a persistent STATE leaf (isBlownAway), not an event leaf: any table change after the annihilation flips it, even if the annihilation event itself was missed. The 'annihilated' game term is implemented as blown-away.

This is a self-inflicted downgrade gate for the opponent to trigger? No - Tracked Fleet is YOUR setup card; its annihilation (via Epic Event mechanics) is the flip driver. No control/occupy anywhere in the flip law.

Back place-out-of-play uses an event leaf: TriggerConditions.justForfeitedToLostPileFromLocation(Filters.Kylo, Filters.and(Filters.Crait_Salt_Plateau, Filters.wherePresent(self, Filters.or(Filters.Han, Filters.Leia, Filters.Luke)))) AND GameConditions.isDuringBattleLostBy(game, playerId) (Card225_032_BACK.java:98-102). 'Present' semantics via Filters.wherePresent.

Back drain bonus condition: OccupiesWithCondition(self, playerId, Filters.Crait_location, Filters.Kylo) - Kylo OCCUPIES a Crait location (Card225_032_BACK.java:135); drain-lock/retrieval-cancel condition: ControlsWithCondition(self, playerId, Filters.Crait_Salt_Plateau, Filters.Kylo) - Kylo CONTROLS Salt Plateau (Card225_032_BACK.java:140) and GameConditions.controlsWith(game, self, playerId, Filters.Crait_Salt_Plateau, Filters.Kylo) for retrieval cancel (114-115). The occupy-vs-control split between the two Kylo conditions is explicit in source.

Back may-not-drain modifier as coded: MayNotForceDrainAtLocationModifier(self, Filters.sameLocationAs(self, Filters.and(Filters.sameLocationAs(self, Filters.and(Filters.opponents(self), Filters.characterOrPermanentPilotAlone)))), kyloControlsSaltPlateau, opponent) - a double-wrapped sameLocationAs expression (Card225_032_BACK.java:141-142); recorded exactly as written.
typedIdentities: Filters.Tracked_Fleet (setup deploy; flip trigger card via blown-away state)
Filters.Kylo (persona; back engines and out-of-play hazard)
Filters.or(Filters.Han, Filters.Leia, Filters.Luke) (personas; out-of-play hazard arming, via Filters.wherePresent at Salt Plateau)

Filters.and(Filters.battleground, Filters.occupiesWith(playerId, self, Filters.and(Filters.First_Order_character, Filters.with(self, Filters.First_Order_character)))) (back drain +1 target class: battlegrounds with two co-located First Order characters)
Deploy ban (remainder of game): Filters.or(Filters.Bow_To_The_First_Order, Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.hasAbilityOrHasPermanentPilotWithAbility, Filters.not(Icon.EPISODE_VII)))
Back Lost Pile deploy: Filters.or(Filters.and(Filters.non_unique, Filters.trooper), Filters.and(Filters.non_unique, Icon.FIRST_ORDER, Filters.vehicle))
setupAndPullRoutes: Start of game (required, from Reserve Deck): D'Qar system (Card225_032.java:49), Crait system (56), Salt Plateau (63), Tracked Fleet (70).

FRONT and BACK (same GameTextActionId.THE_FIRST_ORDER_REIGNS__DOWNLOAD_EPISODE_7_BATTLEGROUND, once per turn): deploy a card with 'Supremacy' in title or an [Episode VII] battleground from Reserve Deck (Card225_032.java:90-110; Card225_032_BACK.java:50-65).

BACK: once per turn, deploy a non-unique trooper or non-unique [First Order] vehicle from LOST PILE (Card225_032_BACK.java:67-86, GameTextActionId.THE_RESISTANCE_IS_DOOMED__DOWNLOAD_FIRST_ORDER_VEHICLE_OR_TROOPER).
otherObligations: FOR REMAINDER OF GAME (granted after deployment completes, Card225_032.java:80-87): may not deploy Bow To The First Order or your cards with ability except [Episode VII] cards.
FRONT: opponent loses no more than 1 Force to your Force drains at systems (Card225_032.java:118); Supremacy deploy = 7 to [Episode VII] systems (119).

BACK: while Kylo occupies a Crait location, your drains at battlegrounds with two First Order characters are +1 (Card225_032_BACK.java:134-137); while Kylo controls Salt Plateau, opponent may not Force drain where their character or permanent pilot is alone (139-142) and opponent's Force retrieval is canceled (RequiredGameTextTriggerAction CancelForceRetrievalEffect, 113-123).
BACK HAZARD: objective placed OUT OF PLAY if Kylo just forfeited from a battle you lost at Salt Plateau with Han, Leia, or Luke present (Card225_032_BACK.java:96-111).

Rando obligations: front - engineer Tracked Fleet's annihilation to flip; back - park Kylo on Salt Plateau (control) for the retrieval-lock and drain-lock, but NEVER forfeit Kylo in a losing battle there while Han/Leia/Luke is present.
